critical_code_review_comments: Feature confirmed working end-to-end. First attempt in this iteration only appeared to fail due to test-side timing (toggling two switches within 300ms before saving). With a 1200ms settle after opening the Media tab and 500ms between toggles, both media_visible and tab_visibility flips persist reliably. Consider: if a real admin can 'double-click fast', React batched state may still merge fine — but if any regression appears, ensure setForm callbacks use the functional form: setForm(prev => ({...prev, media_visible: !prev.media_visible})) to prevent stale-state closures. Not blocking.

Google session endpoint contract clean: 400 (no header) / 401 (bad header). Non-allowlisted valid Google session cannot be automated here; recommend a unit test on backend using a monkeypatched session-data endpoint to fully cover allowlist rejection path (403/401).
